sources.entry: Thyme - The task timer for OS X.

summary.one_liner: Thyme is a simple task timer app for OS X (macOS).
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and says only that Thyme is a timer for OS X. It names a separate "Thyme Web" heading with the line "Not using Mac OS?", but gives no details about what that web version does. The README does not describe features, setup steps, or how the timer tracks tasks. The repository was listed under the Productivity section of an open-source macOS apps list, where it is described as "the task timer for OS X." Because the README is nearly empty, this summary relies mainly on that metadata.
use_cases: track time spent on tasks on a Mac
simple desktop timer for OS X
notable: Minimal timer app for OS X, described as simple
Has a related Thyme Web variant for non-Mac users, per the README heading
caveats: README is nearly empty; no install or usage instructions are given
Targets OS X; the README does not say whether it runs on current macOS versions
